I joined this gym just a week ago, and I am genuinely impressed. Over the years, I have worked out at many gyms, but this one stands out for all the right reasons.

featured_reviews.review_text: Joined today and had a really good experience! The vibe is nice and motivating. Trainer Aman guided me properly throughout the session and was very supportive. Even when he was busy, trainer Saurabh stepped in and helped me. The trainers here are really helpful. After today’s session, I’m confident about upgrading my monthly membership to a yearly one. featured_reviews.name: Nehal Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I truly don’t have enough words to express my gratitude to my trainer, Aman Sir.
For the past 7 years, I have been suffering from severe leg and ankle pain, along with swelling. I had almost lost hope and believed that my weight was the main reason behind all my problems. Because of this, I could only wear soft, comfort footwear and had accepted it as my reality.
But everything changed after I started training with him.
He didn’t just train me—he transformed my mindset and lifestyle. Every single day, he pushed me beyond my limits, counting each rep with me and ensuring I gave my best. Yes, there was pain, especially in my legs, but it was the kind of pain that builds strength, not breaks you.
Along with strength and body shape, he has also significantly improved my flexibility, which has made a huge difference in my daily movements and overall comfort.
Today, I feel stronger, more flexible, more confident, and happier from within. For the first time in years, I can wear normal footwear—and that itself feels like a huge achievement for me.
He guided me not just with workouts but also with a proper diet plan and constant motivation. At times, his guidance felt like lectures—but now I realize their true value. Even though I’ve implemented only 5% of what he has taught me, I can already see a major transformation in my life. I can only imagine what I can achieve if I follow it 100%.
Thank you, Aman Sir. Calling you a “life changer” or “transformer” still feels like an understatement.
“Thank you” is truly a small word for what you’ve done for me.
Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious!

featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing gym with top-quality equipment and a great workout vibe. Very clean, well maintained, and never feels overcrowded. Trainers are supportive and knowledgeable. One of the best gyms in Malad/Kandivali—highly recommended! 💪

featured_reviews.name: rizwan khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Absolute Game-Changer of a Gym!
​I have tried several gyms over the years, but ABD Gym stands head and shoulders above the rest. From the moment you walk through the doors, the atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, high-energy, and motivating.
​The facility itself is top-tier. It boasts a massive variety of state-of-the-art equipment, meaning you rarely have to wait for a machine, even during peak hours. Whether you are looking for an extensive free weight section, specialized strength machines, or modern cardio equipment, they have absolutely everything you need. Cleanliness is also clearly a massive priority here; the gym floor, the equipment, and the locker rooms are consistently spotless.
​However, what truly sets ABD Gym apart is the staff and the community. The personal trainers are exceptional—highly knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely invested in helping you hit your goals without being overly pushy. The front desk team always greets you with a smile and remembers your name, creating a fantastic, supportive environment that feels like a second home.
